# Autoikigai

## About
Autoikigai builds AI-native systems for independent insurance agencies. We automate the repetitive operational work that keeps agency owners and CSRs stuck: renewal follow-ups, lapse prevention, certificate issuance, endorsement processing, new business intake, cross-sell detection, and claims follow-up.

## What We Do
- Agency AI Audit ($5,000): Complete audit of agency workflows, AMS integrations, and automation opportunities. Delivered as a blueprint with ROI projections.
- AI-Native System Build & Maintenance ($2,000-$5,000/month): Ongoing deployment and maintenance of AI-native systems that handle agency operations 24/7.

## AMS Integrations
We integrate with: Applied Epic, AMS360 (Vertafore), HawkSoft, EZLynx, QQCatalyst, comparative raters, and carrier portals. If your AMS has an API or supports CSV exports, we can work with it.

## Who We Work With
Independent insurance agencies writing $1M-$10M in premium. Agencies with 3-30 employees where CSRs are drowning in repetitive tasks and retention rates are under 92%.

## AI-Native Capabilities
- Renewal Automation: Automated 60/45/30/15-day renewal sequences via email, SMS, and phone task creation in your AMS
- Lapse Prevention: Real-time monitoring of payment status and cancellation notices with automated outreach
- CSR Task Automation: Certificate issuance, endorsement processing, policy change requests, ID card generation
- New Business Intake: Application processing, quote comparison, submission to carriers, follow-up sequences
- Cross-Sell Detection: Policy gap analysis across book of business with automated recommendation campaigns
- Claims Follow-Up: Status tracking, adjuster communication, client updates, documentation reminders
- AMS Updates: Activity logging, suspense management, data entry, attachment filing
- Client Communication: Personalized email, SMS, and letter generation for any touchpoint

## Results
- Renewal touch rates: from under 40% to over 90% in the first month
- CSR time freed up within the first week
- First AI-native workflow live within 2-3 weeks
- Complete E&O audit trail on every automated touchpoint

## Pricing
- Agency AI Audit: starts at $5,000 (one-time)
- AI-Native System Maintenance: $2,000-$5,000/month (ongoing)
